title: ATF Audit Event
description: One entry in the append-only Audit Ledger hash chain (docs/PRD.md §16). atf-audit produces this shape and services/gateway records events on the live Shadow Mode request path.

event_id.description: Unique id for this event, e.g. a ULID.

intent_id.description: Null for events not tied to one Intent, e.g. PolicyChanged, AgentPaused, KillSwitchTriggered.

prev_event_hash.description: Hex-encoded hash of the previous event in the chain (PRD §16.3). Null only for the very first event ever recorded.

data.description: Event-type-specific payload — PRD §16.2 lists the event types but not a fixed per-type field set, so this is intentionally open.
